node.title: Re^5: Joining multiple lines together while parsing
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
so I can use it for csv?

Use [mod://Text::CSV]:

use Text::CSV; my $csv = Text::CSV->new({binary=>1, always_quote=>1, blank_is_undef=>1, eol=>$/, auto_diag=>2}); $csv->print(select, ['foo', 'bar']); __END__ "foo","bar"

Replace the call to [doc://select] with a $filehandle ([doc://open]) if you're writing to a file.
